mainEntity.name: How much does a Range Rover Sport D350 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A reconditioned or rebuilt AJ300D engine for the Range Rover Sport D350 typically ranges from £5,500 to £9,000 for supply only, depending on the condition and specialist.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of DPF or EGR failure in a Range Rover Sport D350?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early signs include unexplained loss of power, excessive black smoke from the exhaust, or frequent warning lights requesting DPF regeneration.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a modern Range Rover Sport D350?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, given the high retained value of the L461 Range Rover Sport D350 (typically £55,000+), a rebuilt engine is a financially sound investment.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Range Rover Sport D350 engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service for the AJ300D engine typically takes 3 to 5 days due to the complexity of the inline-six layout and ancillary systems.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a used and a rebuilt Range Rover Sport D350 engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: A used engine is a direct salvage unit with unknown history and limited warranty coverage.

commonProblems.h2: Range Rover Sport D350 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Range Rover Sport D350 is a capable, modern mild-hybrid diesel designed for heavy loads and towing. However, its 3.0L Ingenium architecture is susceptible to specific emissions-related and ancillary issues. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: DPF & EGR System Blockages - Why the Range Rover Sport D350 AJ300D Suffers Premature Wear
problems.rootCause: Frequent short journeys prevent complete DPF regeneration, leading to soot buildup and back-pressure, while the EGR valve is prone to carbon fouling and restricted airflow.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Diagnostic tool initiation of stationary regen, chemical cleaning of the EGR valve and intake manifold.
repairOptions.longevity: Effective for early-stage symptoms; prevents catastrophic turbo or engine damage.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if the engine has suffered catastrophic overheating, turbo damage, or severe internal blockage.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Range Rover Sport D350 (L461) is worth £55,000-£90,000+ `[THIRD-PARTY]`. At this value, a rebuilt engine replacement cost is a small fraction of the vehicle's overall value, making replacement highly viable to preserve the asset.
problems.recommendation: If the issue is strictly early-stage DPF/EGR related, a specialist service, software update, and cleaning is the most cost-effective fix. However, if there is accompanying loss of compression, turbo failure, or internal damage, a fully rebuilt unit with all known vulnerabilities addressed is the safest long-term choice for a vehicle of this caliber.

items.question: What are the signs of DPF or EGR failure in a Range Rover Sport D350?
items.answer: Early signs include unexplained loss of power, excessive black smoke from the exhaust, or frequent warning lights requesting DPF regeneration.
keyPoints: You may also notice rough idling, increased fuel consumption, or a distinct smell of sulphur.
Ignoring these signs can lead to catastrophic turbo or internal engine damage.
items.cta: -> Get your Range Rover Sport D350 engine checked by a specialist.

items.question: Is it worth replacing the engine in a modern Range Rover Sport D350?
items.answer: Yes, given the high retained value of the L461 Range Rover Sport D350 (typically £55,000+), a rebuilt engine is a financially sound investment.
keyPoints: A rebuilt unit restores factory performance and includes a 12-month warranty.
It is significantly more cost-effective than purchasing a new vehicle.
items.cta: -> View rebuilt Range Rover Sport D350 engine options.

items.question: How long does a Range Rover Sport D350 engine replacement take?
items.answer: A professional supply and fit service for the AJ300D engine typically takes 3 to 5 days due to the complexity of the inline-six layout and ancillary systems.
keyPoints: This includes engine removal, thorough bay cleaning, installation of the replacement unit, and comprehensive ECU calibration.
Nationwide delivery of the replacement engine can be arranged to your chosen specialist.
items.cta: -> Book a Range Rover Sport D350 supply and fit appointment.

items.question: What is the difference between a used and a rebuilt Range Rover Sport D350 engine?
items.answer: A used engine is a direct salvage unit with unknown history and limited warranty coverage.
keyPoints: A rebuilt engine is fully stripped, cleaned, and fitted with new or upgraded components (such as updated EGR valves and DPF systems).
Rebuilt engines come with a minimum 12-month unlimited mileage warranty, offering superior peace of mind.
